name: amp-inbox-band
description: Shows unread AMP messages above the prompt, in the status line and as a toast, and can wake an idle Claude Code session to read them. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later.

autoWake.title: Wake on new messages
autoWake.description: Submit a prompt to read the inbox when new AMP messages arrive and the session is idle. Spends usage. Off by default.
